column1: # Totality baseline: every compiler declaration that is not total today (R-0506 totality lint;
# scripts/tests/check_totality_ratchet.sh). The list may only SHRINK. A declaration that becomes
# total must be deleted from it; a declaration that is not total and not listed fails the gate.
# Rows come from the elaborated environment (scripts/tools/totality_inventory.lean), not from grep,
# so deriving-generated instances and `where`/`mutual` helpers are here and inert `partial`
# keywords on non-recursive definitions are not.
# kind       partial | unsafe | opaque | implemented_by | extern (sorry and axiom rows are never admissible)
# stage      from docs/compiler/totality_stages.tsv; proof-relevant stages need a reason code
# recursion  for partial: self | mutual (as the environment shows it); otherwise -
# argtypes   for partial: the nested or mutual inductive types among its argument types; otherwise -
# reason     a code from scripts/tools/totality_ratchet.py REASONS, explained with its conversion in
#            research/compiler/partial-def-inventory-2026-10.md; seeded by a source heuristic, correct by hand
# owner      the roadmap row whose delivery needs the stage total
